The one- and two-assay within-primary conditional means are f and f^2 in the unoccupied class, and g=f+theta(p-f) and h=f^2+theta(p^2-f^2) in the occupied class. Cross-primary products factor in each class. Thus C-A^2=psi(1-psi)theta^2(p-f)^2 and D-AB=(p+f)(C-A^2); the two ordered roots, positive T=A-f, and those identities recover every parameter. Inclusion-exclusion on the eight cells proves equivalence of the interior feasibility criterion with the stated equal-marginal/exchangeability constraints. An independent exact forward-Jacobian determinant in the stated parameter order is psi^2 theta^4(p-f)^6(psi-1); the four example moments also agree. A single primary reveals only psi theta; one read per primary reveals only psi, f and g, hence exact continuous aliases with theta(p-f) unchanged. These exhaust fixed allocations with at most three binary assays drawn as stated. The uniqueness of the allocation is for a repeated fixed panel, not for recorded heterogeneous panels: for example, three distinct primaries on some sites give psi,f,g by the ordinary three-repeat binary mixture, and a within-primary pair on other sites then determines p from B=f^2+(A-f)(p+f). This is outside the fixed-panel theorem.
